newsitem.title: USA: Greater China buys fiber optic cable co.
newsitem.headline: Greater China buys fiber optic cable co.

text.p: Greater China Corp said Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to merge with International Technology Group, a private Hong Kong-based firm.

International Technology Group, through its operating subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fiber optic cable materials and supplies to telecommunications providers in China and the greater Asian market.
The companies said they expect to close the proposed transaction by September 19.
The deal is pending certain conditions including the receipt of board approval of both companies and a commitment by Greater China Corp for financing during the next nine months of about $5 million.
The financing is to be used for the development of opportunities within the fiber optic field in the China market.
At the time of closing, the shareholders of the Greater China Corp and International Technology Group will each own 50 percent of the combined public entity.
